mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy heads towards a potential recession.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts the economy and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, indicating a tight monetary policy, and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy slows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, indicating a very tight labor market, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies raise wages and boost consumer spending.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) are rising faster than real GDP (GDPC1), it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 45% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising faster than the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), it signals strong supply-side growth without inflationary pressures, which predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth > CPIAUCSL growth, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.
